resolutions.resolution: Sal: "a". A taken in its general form: any unwalked pass on an unpassed or stale gate with no open pair names the walk before the slot's review. The walk precedes every review on the recommended path, so the earlier-slot qualifier in the option text is not needed.

options_presented.label: A
options_presented.body: Widen the rule to the unpassed side: when an EARLIER slot's pass is unwalked (SUGGESTION-only) and the next uncovered slot is a later one, the unpassed gate's canonical next is the walk first. Walking before the following pass raises no bar, so the loop never forms. This revises exit (3) under R-crc-12 and adds rows to the selection table.
